readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with the prologue’s wallet, then use the design grammar to compare its contents. Follow a local experiment before moving into cryptocurrency and programmable financial systems. The later stress comparisons reveal consequences a catalogue of innovations would easily miss. This book suits readers interested in monetary institutions as well as technical novelty. Its depth lies in comparing purposes, governing powers, and failures across different traditions. You need not endorse every proposal to make that comparison useful. Read it to recognize which promises your money carries, and who can rewrite them.
